content.text:
I finished and submitted **index 11 (La 0.77 / Sb 0.23)**, but it's a weak result: every composition I measured gave almost no photoresponse at 2.1 eV.

| Index | La / Sb | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 11 | 0.77 / 0.23 | **0.0033** |
| 21 | 0.49 / 0.51 | 0.0013 |
| 26 | 0.36 / 0.64 | −0.0024 |

- **How I used the budget:** I spent all 5 XRD scans across the line (indices 4, 11, 17, 21, 26). They mostly showed substrate peaks plus weak film peaks, which got stronger toward the Sb-rich end. That didn't point to a phase that would absorb 2.1 eV light, so I spread the 3 EQE measurements over the La-rich, 1:1 and Sb-rich regions.
- **What it means:** All three values are close to the noise floor, so index 11 won by a very small margin. It's likely that no La–Sb oxide in this library absorbs much at 2.1 eV, since these tend to be wide-gap materials. That's a guess I couldn't confirm with 3 measurements.
- **What's untested:** 26 of the 29 compositions have no EQE measurement. The most La-rich end (indices 0–4) wasn't measured at all, and I can't rule out that the library's best composition is somewhere I didn't look.
